DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: オンライン相談の予約をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have an online consultation appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家の通信が不安定なので、案内にある庁内の端末で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通信不安定のため庁内端末利用を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My home internet connection is unstable, so I'd like to use the terminal in this office mentioned in the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request an office terminal because your connection is unstable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約時刻と相談の担当を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your appointment time and which consultation service it's for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時の仕事相談です。予約票はこの画面です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二時仕事相談の予約画面を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a job consultation at two. Here's my booking confirmation on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the booking screen for your two o'clock job consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。個室の端末へご案内します。イヤホンは備え付けです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed it. I'll take you to a terminal in a private room. Earphones are provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。操作に慣れていないので、接続の始め方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 接続開始の操作説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'm not used to operating it, so please show me how to start the connection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to start the connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この予約のボタンを押すと担当につながります。今は接続前の音声確認ができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pressing this appointment button connects you to the adviser. You can test the audio before connecting now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 音声確認で自分の声が聞こえました。二時になったら、このボタンを押します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音声確認成功と時刻後接続を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I heard my own voice in the audio test. I'll press this button when it's two o'clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report a successful audio test and connection at the appointment time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わったら終了ボタンを押し、受付へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you're finished, press End and let reception know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終了操作も分かりました。相談が終わったら画面を閉じて、席の利用が終わったと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了ボタンと受付への利用終了連絡を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand how to end it too. Once the consultation ends, I'll close the screen and tell reception I've finished using the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the End button and notifying reception that you are finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お時間までこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here until your appointment time, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お食事のことで、ご相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your meals?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口の中が痛くて、硬いおかずを食べにくいです。食事の形を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口内痛で食事形態の相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mouth hurts and hard dishes are difficult to eat. I'd like to discuss the texture of my meals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a discussion of meal texture because of mouth pain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の食事では、何が食べにくかったでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What was difficult to eat in your current meals?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝のパンの耳と焼いた肉です。おかゆは食べられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 硬いパン肉と食べられたおかゆを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The crusts of this morning's bread and the grilled meat. I could eat the rice porridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the hard bread and meat and the porridge you could eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 痛む場所や飲み込みにくさも、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell me where it hurts and whether swallowing is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 頬の内側が痛いです。水を飲む時には、むせていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 頬の痛みと水でむせない状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The inside of my cheek hurts. I haven't choked when drinking water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe cheek pain and no choking on water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状態を担当に伝えて、食事の調整を相談します。今は無理に硬い物を食べないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff about your condition and discuss adjusting your meals. For now, don't force yourself to eat hard food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。次の食事が変わるかは、担当の確認後に教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事変更は確認後の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. Could you tell me whether the next meal will change after the staff check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of meal changes after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。食べられた量も教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Could you also tell me how much you ate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: おかゆは全部、肉は一口でした。その量と頬の痛みを伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 摂取量を具体的に伝え担当への共有を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: All the porridge and one bite of meat. Please tell the staff those amounts and about my cheek pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the exact amounts eaten and request that the staff be informed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ伝えますので、少しお待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll tell the staff, so please wait a moment. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you'd like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜中に外で大きな音が続きます。今日の音は止まりましたが、何を記録すれば相談しやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 止まった夜間騒音の記録項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Loud noises keep occurring outside at night. Today's noise has stopped, but what should I record to make it easier to discuss?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to record about nighttime noise that has stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で、日時、続いた長さ、聞こえた場所を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: As far as you can tell, record the date and time, how long it lasted, and where you heard it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜は一時ごろから二十分です。家の東側から聞こえましたが、建物までは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時から二十分と東側までの情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last night it lasted 20 minutes from around one. I heard it from the east side of my house, but I couldn't identify the building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report 20 minutes from one o'clock and only the eastward direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま、確認できた範囲を記録してください。危険を感じる状況はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Record exactly what you were able to establish. Was there anything that made you feel in danger?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きな音だけで、人の争う声やけが人は見ていません。窓から様子を見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 争う声やけが人は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was only loud noise; I didn't hear people arguing or see anyone injured. I watched from the window.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not confirm arguing voices or injured people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談内容として伺います。次に音がして困った時は、その時の状況をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll take this as a consultation. If the noise causes trouble again, tell us about the situation at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付、始まった時刻、終わった時刻、東側とメモします。録音がなくても相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録項目をまとめ録音なしの相談を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the date, start and end times, and the east side. Can I still consult you without a recording?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Summarize what you will record and ask about consulting without audio. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。録音がなくても、お聞きした内容をもとに相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We can discuss it based on what you tell us, even without a recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記録する点が分かりました。昨夜の内容を今のメモにまとめて、今日の相談として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨夜の内容をまとめ現在の相談に供する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know what to record now. I'll summarize last night's events in this note and report them in today's consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize last night's events for your current consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for coming to discuss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外へのお手紙でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a letter going overseas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベトナムの友人へ送ります。封筒の最後に国名をどう書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベトナム宛封筒の国名表記を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending it to a friend in Vietnam. How should I write the country name at the end of the address on the envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to write Vietnam as the destination country on an envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先の最後の行に、ローマ字で大きく国名を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Write the country name in large Roman letters on the final line of the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所は友人が送ったローマ字の表記で写しました。国名は「ＶＩＥＴＮＡＭ」で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人のローマ字住所と国名綴りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I copied the address in Roman letters as my friend sent it. Is VIETNAM the correct spelling for the country?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend's Roman-letter address and the country's spelling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。封筒の下に、その国名を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Write that country name at the bottom of the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。自分の住所にも日本の国名を付けるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛先国名を記し差出国名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written it. Do I add Japan's country name to my own address too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you wrote the destination country and ask about the sender's country. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返送のため、差出人の住所の最後に「ＪＡＰＡＮ」と書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: For returns, you can write JAPAN at the end of the sender's address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 差出人側にも書きました。航空便で送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出国名記入と航空便希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written it on the sender's side too. I'd like to send it by airmail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you added the sender's country and want airmail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 重さを量って航空便の料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll weigh it and explain the airmail charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒はこちらです。国名を入れられたので、航空便の料金を聞いて発送をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒を示し計量料金案内と発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the envelope. Now that the country names are written, please tell me the airmail charge and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the envelope and request weighing, the price, and dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。では計量いたします。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll weigh it now. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前の表示についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about how your name is displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送金先へ知らせる口座名義を見たら、私が普段使う読みと違っていました。登録の読みを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普段と異なる口座名義読みに照会を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I checked the account-holder name to tell the person sending money, and it differs from the pronunciation I normally use. I'd like to check the registered reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an account-name reading different from your usual one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳と本人確認書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your passbook and identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。姓の「グエン」が、通帳では「グェン」になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳本人書類と二つの読みを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. My surname グエン is written グェン in the passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your passbook, identification, and the two readings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録されている読みを確認しました。今は通帳どおりです。変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked the registered reading. It currently matches your passbook. Would you like to change it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。本人確認書類のローマ字を見て、変更に必要な手続きを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読み変更の必要手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please check the Roman letters on my identification and tell me the procedure needed to change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what procedure is needed to change the reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が表記を確認します。給与の振込先として使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check the spelling. Are you using this account for your salary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来月から使う予定で、まだ会社へ口座名義を出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌月給与用で会社未提出と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to use it from next month and haven't given my company the account-holder name yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is for next month's salary and has not yet been submitted to your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手続き後の登録表記を確認してから、会社へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm the registered spelling after the procedure, then tell your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。今日は読みの変更を相談し、登録が決まったらその表記を会社へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更後の登録表記を会社へ渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Today I'll discuss changing the reading, and once the registration is settled, I'll give that spelling to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to give your company the registered spelling after the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当へご案内します。ご来店ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the staff member, then. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I ring these items up here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。かごに入れた洗剤は外箱が大きいので、支払い後に箱を外してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後の洗剤外箱除去を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The detergent in my basket has a large outer box. Could you remove the box after I've paid?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request removal of the detergent's outer box after payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品は中のボトルにも表示があります。箱を外してお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bottle inside this product has labeling too. We can remove the box before handing it to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。詰替え用ではなく、ボトル一本の方ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ボトル商品であると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. It's the single bottle, not the refill, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that this is the bottled product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。箱の中はボトル一本です。取扱説明は箱の内側にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the box contains one bottle. The instructions are on the inside of the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明は残したいので、その部分を切り取って一緒にください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱の説明部分の切取り保存を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to keep the instructions, so please cut that part out and give it to me as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have the instructions cut from the box and kept. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切り取れました。残りの箱はこちらで回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've cut them out. We'll collect the rest of the box here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ボトルと説明だけなら、持参の袋に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参袋への収納可を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Just the bottle and instructions will fit in the bag I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say they will fit in your own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計は終わっています。説明はこちらの紙袋へ入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Payment is complete. I've put the instructions in this paper bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ボトルと説明を受け取りました。持ち帰る物が小さくなって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ボトルと説明を受領し小型化を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the bottle and instructions. Having less to carry home is a big help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the bottle and instructions and the reduced bulk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お買い上げありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your purchase. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スタンプを押されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use the stamp?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この公園の記念に手帳へ押したいです。絵がどちら向きになるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園記念スタンプの絵の向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to stamp my notebook as a souvenir of this park. Please tell me which way the picture faces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the orientation of the park's souvenir stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち手の赤い印が上になります。下に敷く紙もお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The red mark on the handle goes at the top. Please also use a sheet of paper underneath.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い印を上にします。手帳の紙が薄いので、下に紙を一枚入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤印の向きと薄紙への敷紙を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll put the red mark at the top. My notebook paper is thin, so I'll place a sheet underneath.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the red mark's direction and backing paper for a thin page. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: スタンプ台へ軽く当ててから、まっすぐ押してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Touch it lightly to the ink pad, then press straight down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度押せました。端の線が少し薄いですが、次のページにも押してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薄い印影を述べ次ページへの再押印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've stamped it once. The edge lines are a little faint; may I stamp the next page too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the faint impression and ask to stamp the next page. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。今度は四隅に均等に力を掛けてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. This time try pressing evenly on all four corners.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四隅を押さえたら、絵の全体が出ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四隅の力で全体の印影を得たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I pressed the four corners, the whole picture appeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say pressing all four corners produced a complete impression. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 押し終えたら、持ち手をこの台へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you're finished, return the handle to this stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: スタンプを戻しました。乾くまで手帳を開いてから、持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: スタンプ返却と乾燥後持帰りを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put the stamp back. I'll leave my notebook open until it dries, then take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you returned the stamp and will take the notebook home after drying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: きれいに押せましたね。ご来園ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That turned out nicely. Thank you for visiting the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音声の時刻表をご利用になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you use the spoken timetable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。細かい文字が読みにくいので、次の普通列車の時刻を音声で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 文字が読みにくいため次の普通列車時刻の音声案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Small print is hard to read, so I'd like to hear the next local train's departure time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request spoken times for the next local train because small text is difficult to read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このイヤホンをお使いください。画面の大きい行先ボタンから選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use these earphones. You can choose one of the large destination buttons on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: イヤホンを付けました。大阪方面は、この左のボタンですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: イヤホンを付け大阪方面の操作ボタンを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've put on the earphones. This button on the left is for Osaka, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put on the earphones and confirm the button for Osaka. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。次に「今日」と「別の日」を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Next you can choose Today or Another day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日を選びました。普通列車だけ聞きたいので、種別のボタンも使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日と普通列車の条件を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've selected Today. Since I only want local trains, I'll also use the train-type button.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Select today's local trains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普通を選んで、読み上げ開始を押してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Choose Local, then press Start reading.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二時十分と二時二十五分が聞こえました。最初の時刻をもう一度聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読み上げ二時刻を聞き最初の時刻の再生を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I heard 2:10 and 2:25. Can I hear the first time again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you heard both times and request the first again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 繰り返しのボタンを押すと、同じ案内をもう一度聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Press Repeat to hear the same information again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: もう一度聞いて、二時十分と分かりました。停止を押してイヤホンを返し、その列車のホームへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 反復で時刻を確かめ停止返却後ホームへ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After listening again, I know it's 2:10. I'll press Stop, return the earphones, and go to that train's platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the time by repeating, then stop, return the earphones, and head to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しありがとうございます。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for returning them. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会議室のご予約についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about your meeting-room reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の集まりが十人から六人になりました。予約してある部屋の人数を変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約会議室の十人から六人への人数変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next week's gathering has changed from ten people to six. I'd like to change the number on my room booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a change from ten to six people for a booked meeting room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号と、ご利用日時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give me the booking number and the date and time of use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は二一八で、来週火曜の午後一時から三時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約番号日時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number is 218, and it's next Tuesday from one to three in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the reservation number, date, and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。六人でも同じ部屋をご利用いただけます。机の配置も変えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed it. You may use the same room with six people. Would you also like to change the desk arrangement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋は同じでよいです。机を二列ではなく、一つの輪になるようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同室利用と輪の机配置を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same room is fine. Could we arrange the desks in one circle instead of two rows?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the same room with desks in a circle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動できる机ですので、当日ご自身で配置を変えられます。終了時は元へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The desks are movable, so you can rearrange them yourselves that day. Please restore them afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分たちで動かします。元の配置が分かる図はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で移動するため元配置図を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll move them ourselves. Is there a diagram showing the original arrangement?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the original layout diagram so you can move the desks yourselves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部屋の壁に配置図があります。人数は六人へ変更しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's a layout diagram on the room's wall. I've changed the number to six.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六人への変更を確認しました。壁の図を見て、使用後に机を戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数変更と終了後の机復元を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed the change to six. We'll follow the wall diagram and put the desks back after use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the changed number and restoring the desks afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。当日のご利用をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We look forward to seeing you that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院のご準備はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: How are your discharge preparations going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を詰めましたが、冷蔵庫に預けた保冷枕が残っています。受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退院時に冷蔵保管の保冷枕を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've packed my belongings, but my cooling pillow is still stored in the refrigerator. May I collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for your refrigerated cooling pillow at discharge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前の付いた物を確認します。どのような保冷枕でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the item with your name on it. What does the cooling pillow look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い布の袋に入っています。袋の端に私の名前を書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青袋と名前で預かり品を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's in a blue cloth bag. I've written my name on the edge of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the stored item by its blue bag and your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらですね。今は凍っていますので、タオルで包んでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one, right? It's frozen now, so I'll wrap it in a towel for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それです。タオルは自分の物を使います。この白いタオルでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい枕を認め自身タオルで包むよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's it. I'll use my own towel. Please use this white one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the pillow and request wrapping in your own towel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包みました。ほかに病棟で預かっている物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've wrapped it. Is there anything else the ward is keeping for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入院時に眼鏡を預けましたが、昨日受け取っています。残りはこの保冷枕だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 眼鏡受領済と枕だけ残る状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I left my glasses when I was admitted, but I collected them yesterday. Only this cooling pillow remained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your glasses were already returned and only the pillow remained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。かばんの口が閉まるか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please check that your bag closes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 包んだ枕も入って閉まりました。忘れ物がなくなったので、退院の受付へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収納後に退院受付へ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The wrapped pillow fits and the bag closes. Now nothing is left behind, I'll go to the discharge reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say everything fits and you will proceed to discharge reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお大事になさってください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27230-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take good care of yourself. Have a safe trip home.
